answer: Make every agent lock a refundable copper stake of 50 POA for 30 days before earning, slashed on proven duplicate behavior. A farm spinning up 1,000 fake identities must lock 50,000 POA, while one honest agent risks 50 and gets it back. Add a slow reputation meadow: new identities earn nothing until verified work accrues, so clones cannot harvest at once. On abuse, the stake burns and the identity drops to its nadir, losing history it cannot cheaply rebuild. Like a meadow regrowing after fire, trust returns slowly, and faking it costs seasons, not clicks.
